[7] «The Addiction Tour 2006 | The Addiction Tour 2006 is the first live DVD by the Italian gothic metal band Theatres des Vampires.  It features ten songs recorded during the tour in 2006 and also features an interview with Sonya Scarlet, as well as two music videos the band had recorded for the songs "Lilith Mater Inferorum" and "Angel of Lust".
